docs.title: MAMMA-MIA Visualization Backend
docs.text: Welcome to the documentation for the MAMMA-MIA Visualization Backend.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: The MAMMA-MIA Visualization Backend is a high-performance FastAPI service designed to serve oceanographic data. It exposes API endpoints to retrieve: - Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (ALR) and Glider trajectory data. - Oceanographic sensor metrics, including: - Practical Salinity - Sea Temperature - Chlorophyll sensor data - Multi-dimensional Zarr dataset inspection, metadata, slice query, and tiling capabilities.

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text: The backend consists of: - FastAPI Application (main.py): Entry point defining app middleware (CORS) and dynamic route inclusion. - Zarr Tiler Factory (factory.py): Exposes structured API endpoints for retrieving variables, dimensions, spatial subsets, and data slices. - Zarr Reader Core (reader.py): Utilities for interfacing with Zarr stores, reading metadata, performing coordinate projections (pyproj), and slicing data. - Utilities (utils/): Helper functions for spatial conversions, timestamp parsing, and array processing.

docs.title: Documentation Structure
docs.text:
• Getting Started with MAMMA-MIA backend: Installation, running locally with Uvicorn, and Docker container deployment.
  • API Reference: Detailed information on endpoints, request parameters, response schemas, and interactive Swagger/OpenAPI docs.

docs.title: API Reference
docs.text: The MAMMA-MIA Visualization Backend provides FastAPI endpoints for querying and reading Zarr oceanographic datasets.

docs.title: Interactive API Documentation
docs.text: When running the application, interactive documentation generated by Swagger UI and ReDoc is available: - Swagger UI: http://127.0.0.1:8040/docs - ReDoc: http://127.0.0.1:8040/redoc

docs.title: 1. Dataset Variables
docs.text:
Returns a list of data variables available in a specified Zarr dataset URL and group.

  • URL: /zarr_variables
  • Method: GET
  • Query Parameters:
  • url (string, required): Dataset URL or local store path.
  • group (string, optional): Zarr group to inspect.
  • Response: JSON list of variable strings.

docs.title: 2. Dataset Dimensions
docs.text:
Returns dimensions and their shapes for a specified Zarr dataset.

  • URL: /zarr_dimensions
  • Method: GET
  • Query Parameters:
  • url (string, required): Dataset URL or local store path.
  • group (string, optional): Zarr group to inspect.
  • Response: JSON object mapping dimension names to shapes.

docs.title: CORS Configuration
docs.text: By default, Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) allows requests from http://localhost:8080 (e.g., Angular frontend). Additional origins can be configured in main.py.

docs.title: Getting Started with MAMMA-MIA backend
docs.text: This guide will walk you through setting up and running the MAMMA-MIA Visualization Backend locally or using Docker.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Python: 3.10+ (Python 3.12 recommended)
  • Pip: Latest version
  • Docker & Docker Compose: (Optional, for containerized deployments)

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
1. Clone the Repository 

    git clone https://github.com/your-org/mamma-mia-vis-backend.git
cd mamma-mia-vis-backend

  2. Set Up Virtual Environment (Recommended) 

    python3 -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate

  3. Install Dependencies 

    pip install -r requirements.txt

docs.title: Running Backend API Locally
docs.text:
To start the FastAPI server with auto-reload:

uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8040

Once running, the backend API is available at: - Base API URL: http://127.0.0.1:8040 - Interactive OpenAPI / Swagger Documentation: http://127.0.0.1:8040/docs - ReDoc Documentation: http://127.0.0.1:8040/redoc

docs.title: Running Backend API using Docker
docs.text: You can containerize and run the application using Docker or Docker Compose.

docs.title: Using Docker Compose (Recommended)
docs.text:
Docker Compose builds the container image and automatically mounts the local ./assets/ directory for live data access:

docker-compose up

To run in detached (background) mode: 

docker-compose up -d

docs.title: Using Docker Build
docs.text:
If you prefer building and running the container manually:

  1. Build the Image 

    docker build -t mamma-mia-vis-backend .

  2. Run the Container 

    docker run -p 8040:8040 -v $(pwd)/assets:/app/assets mamma-mia-vis-backend

docs.title: Generating & Viewing Documentation
docs.text:
Project documentation is powered by MkDocs with the Material theme.

  • Serve Documentation Locally (with live reload): 

    mkdocs serve
    Open http://127.0.0.1:8000 in your web browser.

  • Build Static HTML Site: 

    mkdocs build
    The compiled site will be generated in the site/ folder.
